14231.name: Hillcrest River Campground
14231.waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 39.6669,-78.7344: open hilltop field beside the I-68 exit 45 interchange; only water is a small pond at the S edge that the host says is decorative (no fishing), with no pads on it; the 'River' in the name is the host's separate primitive Canal Tunnel River site 3 mi away
14231.inclusion_evidence: Hipcamp listing (active, instant-book, staff-verified, 174 reviews): 60 drive-in RV/tent sites for motor homes and trailers on open grass, FHU +$10/day, dump station, showers -> real transient RV campground; published base $35 + $10 hookups = $45 (2026) <= $50. Only other web presence is pinecliffresort.net, a content farm, deliberately not cited.
14231.note: Open grassy hilltop campground 1/10 mile off I-68 exit 45 east of Cumberland; 60 RV/tent sites, full hookups on request (+$10/day, paid on arrival), dump station, flush toilets and hot shower in season, 24/7 convenience store next door, hiking trails and a decorative pond (no fishing). Same host runs the primitive Canal Tunnel River campground on the North Branch Potomac 3 miles away. Booked through Hipcamp only: $35/night for up to 4 plus $10 for hookups (2026). Hipcamp 95% over 174 reviews. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$42/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
